To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The ATM network can be configured to provide the bandwidth needed for the ATLAS data collection system.

(1) the performance of the event selection system based upon an ATM switching network is limited by the bandwidth and latency of the network, (2) the network bandwidth requirements are dominated by the bandwidth required by the Level 1 trigger, and (3) the network latency requirements are dominated by those of the Level 0 trigger.

the use of ATM switching technology in the ATLAS data collection system will allow to achieve the required performance in terms of bandwidth and latency, but the use of ATM in this environment requires a significant amount of research and development work.
